description.zh: BDS集群ID，可调用[DescribeInstances](~~144595~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the BDS cluster. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to obtain the cluster ID.

description.zh: 主实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the primary instance.

description.zh: 主实例zk地址。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填。
description.en: The ZooKeeper address of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false).

description.zh: 主实例集群类型，目前支持**HBase**和**HBaseue**。
description.en: The cluster type of the primary instance. Valid values: **HBase** and **HBaseue**.

description.zh: 主实例hdfs的目录。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填。
description.en: The HDFS directory of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false).

description.zh: 主实例的hdfs链接地址。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填。
description.en: The HDFS URI of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false).

description.zh: 主实例用户名对应的密码。主实例为**HBaseue**时必填。
description.en: The password that corresponds to the username of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is **HBaseue**.

description.zh: 主实例用户名。主实例为**HBaseue**时必填。
description.en: The username of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is **HBaseue**.

description.zh:
主实例数据库版本。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填。
- **HBase1x**：hbase1.x版本。
- **HBase2x**：hbase2.x版本。
- **HBaseUE**：hbaseue版本。
description.en:
The database engine version of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false). Valid values:
- **HBase1x**: HBase 1.x.
- **HBase2x**: HBase 2.x.
- **HBaseUE**: HBaseue.

description.zh:
同步类型。
- **CLUSTER**：实例级别。
- **TABLE**： 表级别。
- **SKIP**：无需同步。
description.en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:
- **CLUSTER**: instance-level synchronization.
- **TABLE**: table-level synchronization.
- **SKIP**: no synchronization required.

description.zh: 备实例集群ID。
description.en: The ID of the secondary instance cluster.

description.zh: 备实例zk地址。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填。
description.en: The ZooKeeper address of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false).

description.zh: 备实例集群类型。目前支持**HBase**和**HBaseue**。
description.en: The cluster type of the secondary instance. Valid values: **HBase** and **HBaseue**.

description.zh: 备实例hdfs的目录。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填。
description.en: The HDFS directory of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false).

description.zh: 备实例的hdfs链接地址。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填。
description.en: The HDFS URI of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false).

description.zh: 备实例用户名对应的密码。备实例为**hbaseue**时必填。
description.en: The password that corresponds to the username of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is **hbaseue**.

description.zh: 备实例用户名。备实例为**hbaseue**时必填。
description.en: The username of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is **hbaseue**.

description.zh:
备实例数据库版本。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填。
- **HBase1x** ：hbase1.x版本。
- **HBase2x**：hbase2.x版本。
- **HBaseUE** ：hbaseue版本。
description.en:
The database engine version of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false). Valid values:
- **HBase1x**: HBase 1.x.
- **HBase2x**: HBase 2.x.
- **HBaseUE**: HBaseue.

description.zh: HaMigrateType为TABLE级别时该项为必填，多个表用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The tables to synchronize. This parameter is required when HaMigrateType is set to TABLE. Separate multiple tables with commas (,).

description.zh: 主实例是否为标准实例，标准实例为**true**。
description.en: Specifies whether the primary instance is a standard instance. Set this parameter to **true** for a standard instance.

description.zh: 备实例是否为标准实例，标准实例为**true**。
description.en: Specifies whether the secondary instance is a standard instance. Set this parameter to **true** for a standard instance.

title.zh: 在BDS集群中添加主备双活实例
title.en: Add an active-active instance pair to a BDS cluster

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase relate-db-for-hbase-ha --cluster-id bds-t4nj9v2x85000000 --ha-tables test,test1 --ha-active-hdfs-uri hdfs://hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master1-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master2-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020 --ha-active-hbase-fs-dir /hbase --ha-active-cluster-key hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master1-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master3-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master2-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com:2181:/hbase --ha-active-version HBase2x --ha-active-user root --ha-active-password root --ha-standby-hdfs-uri hdfs://hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master1-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020,hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master2-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020 --ha-standby-hbase-fs-dir /hbase --ha-standby-cluster-key hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master1-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master3-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master2-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com:2181:/hbase --ha-standby-version HBase2x --ha-standby-user root --ha-standby-password root --ha-active hb-bp1w6krp539000000 --ha-standby hb-bp1bl7iqzka000000 --ha-active-db-type hbase --ha-standby-db-type hbase --is-active-standard true --is-standby-standard true --ha-migrate-type CLUSTER --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbase RelateDbForHBaseHa --region cn-hangzhou --HaStandbyClusterKey 'hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master1-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master3-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master2-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com:2181:/hbase' --HaStandbyVersion HBase2x --HaActiveClusterKey 'hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master1-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master3-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master2-001.hbase.singapore.rds.aliyuncs.com:2181:/hbase' --HaStandbyHdfsUri 'hdfs://hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master1-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020,hb-bp1w6krp539000000-master2-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020' --HaActiveHbaseFsDir '/hbase' --HaStandbyHbaseFsDir '/hbase' --ClusterId 'bds-t4nj9v2x85000000' --HaStandby 'hb-bp1bl7iqzka000000' --HaActiveDBType hbase --HaMigrateType CLUSTER --HaActiveUser root --HaStandbyDBType hbase --IsActiveStandard true --HaTables 'test,test1' --HaActiveHdfsUri 'hdfs://hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master1-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020,hb-t4naqsay5gn000000-master2-001.hbase.rds.aliyuncs.com:8020' --HaActivePassword root --HaStandbyPassword root --IsStandbyStandard true --HaActive 'hb-bp1w6krp539000000' --HaStandbyUser root --HaActiveVersion HBase2x
